/**
 * @name Recon: file read taint into code execution
 * @description Track file read contents flowing into eval/exec/compile sinks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/recon-file-read-code-exec
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module FileReadCodeExecConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() and
      source = call.getReturn().getAValueReachableFromSource()
    )
    or
    source =
      API::moduleImport("pathlib")
          .getMember("Path")
          .getReturn()
          .getAValueReachableFromSource()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      (
        call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
        call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
        call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
      ) and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module FileReadCodeExecFlow = TaintTracking::Global<FileReadCodeExecConfig>;

from DataFlow::Node source, DataFlow::Node sink
where FileReadCodeExecFlow::flow(source, sink)
select sink, "Code execution sink reached by data from file read $@.", source, "source"
findings.hypothesis: File contents read from disk flow into code execution sinks (eval/exec/compile)
